_note: A sum qualifying under Income-tax Act, 2025 s.123 — Schedule XV para 1(a): "premium paid for a life insurance policy — (i) in the case of an individual, on life of such individual, spouse of the individual and any child of the individual … subject to paragraph 2" (Gazette 265620, p.561). Entered per policy (LifeInsurancePolicy), never as a plain qualifying payment: para 2 limits each policy's premium to a share of its actual capital sum assured (DED-PREMIUM-SHARE). D-134. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80C(2)(i) (thc p.330): "to effect or to keep in force an insurance on the life of persons specified in sub-section (4)", each premium within s.80C(3)/(3A)'s share (DED-PREMIUM-SHARE). sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md; D-144.
